stem: A streaming query on txn_bronze computes 10-minute tumbling-window deposit totals using withWatermark("event_time", "15 minutes") and writes to a Delta table in append output mode. When is the result for a given window first written to the sink?
choices: As soon as the first event for that window arrives
At the end of every micro-batch, with updated totals each time
Only after the watermark moves past the end of that window
Never, because append mode cannot be used with aggregations
explanation_ja: append モードでは、ウォーターマークが枠の終わりを越えて「もう変わらない」と決まった時点で、その枠が1回だけ書き出されます。毎回更新した値を出すのは update モードです。

stem: Inside foreachBatch, a job writes each micro-batch to two Delta tables. If the job fails and restarts, the same batch may be processed again. What is the recommended way to make the Delta writes idempotent?
choices: Use trigger(availableNow=True) instead of a processing-time trigger
Set the txnAppId and txnVersion (= batchId) options on each Delta write
Call persist() on the micro-batch DataFrame before writing
Delete the checkpoint directory before every restart
explanation_ja: txnAppId と txnVersion(= batchId)を書き込みオプションに付けると、同じバッチの再書き込みを Delta がスキップします。チェックポイントを消すと、むしろ全部読み直して重複します。

stem: A stateful streaming query aggregates transactions by account_id. Which change to the query cannot be restarted from the same checkpoint?
choices: Changing the processing-time trigger interval
Changing maxFilesPerTrigger on the Auto Loader source
Adding a where("amount > 0") filter before the aggregation
Changing the grouping keys to account_id, channel
explanation_ja: トリガー間隔、レート制限、フィルタの追加は、同じチェックポイントのまま変えられます。集計キーの変更は保存済みの状態と形が合わなくなるので、新しいチェックポイントが必要です。

stem: A team on serverless compute wants a Lakeflow Jobs task that runs every hour, processes every new file that has landed since the last run, and then stops. Which trigger should the streaming query use?
choices: trigger(availableNow=True)
trigger(processingTime="1 hour")
trigger(continuous="1 second")
No trigger (the default micro-batch mode)
explanation_ja: availableNow は、開始時点で届いているデータを何回かのマイクロバッチで全部処理してから止まります。ジョブで定期的に動かすのに向いていて、serverless でも使えます。processingTime は止まらずに動き続けます。

stem: A user has USE CATALOG on bank, plus USE SCHEMA and SELECT on the schema bank.retail. Tomorrow, a new table is created in bank.retail. Can the user query it?
choices: No. SELECT must be granted on each table after it is created.
Yes. Privileges granted on a schema apply to current and future objects in it.
Only if the table owner runs GRANT ... ON FUTURE TABLES
Only if the user also has MODIFY on the schema
explanation_ja: スキーマやカタログに付けた権限は、今あるオブジェクトにも、あとから作られるオブジェクトにも引き継がれます。UC に GRANT ... ON FUTURE TABLES という構文はありません。
